title: The Altar of Scars
text: An altar of pale stone, crossed with old cuts like a butcher's block. Carved above it, in a hand that shook: it asks for a scar. The one who already carries the deepest, the carving promises, will be offered something back.

options.label: Present a nagging scar that now burns in the altar's presence, hoping its promise holds true.

outcomes.text: The wound closes, leaving a pale mark of favor in its place.
The altar drinks more than the scar alone, though what it returns is a lesson hard-won.

options.label: The unblooded gives it a first scar.

outcomes.text: The altar opens a deep, clean cut across the palm. They are unblooded no longer.

options.label: Healer's hands bless the altar instead of bleeding on it.

outcomes.text: The altar falls quiet, almost sulking. Around it, the party's cuts begin to close.
